title: Refine retry behavior
body:
## Background

Retries are inconsistent.

## Goal

Define one retry policy.

## Requirements

- Preserve idempotency.

## Design

### Candidate

Use bounded backoff.

#### T2 — Retry limit

- Why: callers need a deterministic retry limit.
- Options: retry three times or five times.
- Recommendation: retry three times.
- Uncertainty: production failure rates are not measured yet.
- Reply example: `T2: three retries`.

## Verification

Exercise retry exhaustion.

## Todo

- [x] T1: Action: Record bounded backoff.
- [ ] T2: Decision: Choose the retry limit.

- Status: in-progress
